prova:
apply Filter.eventually_of_forall
  intro n hn
  exact ⟨SimpleGraph.mk (fun _ _ => False), by
    constructor
    · intro v w h
      have : v = w := by
        exact h
      subst this
      simp [SimpleGraph.isLoop]
    · constructor
      · rw [SimpleGraph.indepNum]
        <;> simp [Finset.mk']
      · rw [SimpleGraph.edgeFinset]
        simp [Finset.mk', Finset.card_empty]
    ⟩
